Indian School of Business Management and Administration, Hyderabad provides 140 UG, PG and Certificate courses in 35 specialisations, namely Auditing & Control, Business Economics, Business Law, Chartered Accountancy and Civil Engineering. Some of the streams in which these courses are offered include Engineering, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce, Mass Communication & Media and Law. The total fee at Indian School of Business Management and Administration, Hyderabad ranges between INR 3,500 to 1,04,880. Indian School of Business Management and Administration, Hyderabad offers all the infrastructural facilities to students.

faqs.question: Does KLE Society's Nijalingappa College refund fees?
faqs.answer: S. Nijalingappa College of KLE Society does not, under any circumstances, accept claims for refunds of fees. reviews.review_heading: Overall the college is very good and student-friendly.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well-maintained and good. It gives a pleasant vibe to the students and it is also a very interesting course, the department also has a library, computer lab, and an auditorium in the basement. The campus is also very good and well-designed.

reviews.review_heading: It is a super college with superb facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have a very big campus. There is Wi-Fi everywhere on campus. There are 4 buildings and every department has a single Wi-Fi. It has more than 200 classrooms and libraries. We have two laboratories for PO and degree students.

It has all kinds of games and competitions.

reviews.review_heading: The teaching is good and now the infrastructure is being developed.

reviews.review_heading: K L E - a review on the evening batch.

reviews.review_heading: There are some decent teachers.
reviews.review_text: Library is good. A  lot of books for general knowledge and current affairs are available. There is also a Wi-Fi facility for the students.  There are multiple computers in the lab.

reviews.review_heading: Our college value for money and students get decent education for a basic graduation.

We have qualified lab attendants for each lab. There is a small canteen inside our college which has limited food options but mostly instant food.

reviews.review_heading: I'm very well satisfied with my college because of good placements compared to 2021 thank you.

In our good hostel facility very well hygienic and sanitized in the canteen good medical facilities. reviews.review_heading: Review of KLE Society’s S.Nijalingappa College.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides every facility like a library, sports, inter-college games, and a menu. The college environment is good. It is safe and secure. Strict actions are taken by the management. Canteen facilities are provided but hostel facilities are not provided in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely a very good college and campus with good faculty. Good placements are done every year.
reviews.review_text: The campus is huge and clean. There are several departments. The classrooms are clean and well maintained. All the classrooms have separate projectors which help us understand the lectures easily. Library is big and well maintained. We can get all kinds of books from there.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good education but placements needs to be better.
reviews.review_text: Course offers a good education. Classrooms are good. Labs were not part of our course. Library is good with a wide range of useful books. There are projector facilities.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the faculty and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: There is a huge campus covering a lot of land with 6 to 7 blocks and a lot of greenery. There is free Wi-Fi in the library for study purposes. There is a food cafe and a lot nearby the college campus. Sports are also available including NCC.

content.Placements: At Rai University, the placement percentage is around 70% for those who are eligible, but companies are coming to our college for placement. The highest placement package for our college students is around 12 LPA, and the average package is around 5-7 LPA. And the lowest packages are around 3 LPA. Also, our college is a Wi-Fi campus where Wi-Fi is available everywhere on the college campus. Classrooms are good. The library is average, where multiple books are available. You can choose any one which you like and grab knowledge. Hostel facilities in our college are too good, where they take care of our privacy and hygiene, and mess quality is also good.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for B.Tech at MRIIRS Faculty of Engineering and Technology?
faqs.answer: Step 1: Fill an online application form through the respective college website.Step 2: Upload your documents.Step 3:12th standard mark sheet (if result is yet not announced : school ID card + score card of XI class / predictive score of XII class issued by school authorities): MandatoryFor UG Engineering Programmes, mark sheets/score of merit defining document i.e. Valid Score of JEE Mains/SAT/UNIGAUGE, as applicable, in which the candidate has appeared.For B.Arch Programme, mark sheets/score of merit defining document i.e. Valid Score of JEE Mains/NATA, as applicable, in which the candidate has appeared.

faqs.question: What is the seat intake for B.Tech at FET MRIIRS?
faqs.answer: The annual seat intake for the B.Tech at FET MRIIRS is Approximately 1,000 seats which are available across all B.Tech programs offered at FET MRIIRS.If we categorize it based on branches then it is Mechanical has the highest intake of 250 - 300 seats.fields like Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI-ML) and Data Science and Analytics might have smaller intakes in the range of 60 to 80 seats initially, but these numbers can increase due to growing demand.The remaining programs generally have intakes between 50 and 150 seats each.

faqs.question: When is FET MRIIRS application forms out?
faqs.answer: The application forms for FET MRIIRS for their B.Tech programs for the upcoming academic year (2024-2025) are not yet available, please do keep visiting their website for regular updates on the Application and also keep in mind that there is an application fee that needs to be paid for filling up the application as an application fee.because the form is generally rolled out between the middle of December and the middle of February of the next year.Also, subscribe to the official newsletter of the FET MRIIRS.

faqs.question: Does FET MRIIRS accept JEE score?
faqs.answer: Yes, FET MRIIRS does accept JEE Main scores for admission to B.Tech programs along with other exams like MRNAT, SAT India, and Uni-GAUGE.Adding more to this a valid JEE Main score is mandatory for admission to most B.Tech programs at FET MRIIRS and as well many other colleges in India. The weightage given to JEE Main scores in the selection process varies depending on the programme and year. You can find the specific weightage for each programme on the FET MRIIRS website.The best part is that the institute has no minimum percentile score required for all the B.Tech Programs, but also one thing to know here is that the cut-off scores for each programme vary.

faqs.question: What are the fees for M.Tech programmes at FET MRIIRS?
faqs.answer: There are multiple M.Tech streams in FET MRIIRS, and the average fees for M.Tech is between 2.1 LPA to 2.6 LPA. There are a total of 16 M.Tech courses in the institution. To check other courses fee you can visit the college website. For M.Tech admissions GATE, CUET -Pg exam is also considered and the eligibility is minmum 50 percent in Graduation (10+2)

faqs.question: What is the fee for B.Tech in EEE at Faculty of Engineering and Technology- Manav Rachna International University?
faqs.answer: Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies (MRIIRS) has a fee structure that comprises of a list of the following components: Tuition Fee Development Fee University Fee Student Resource Fee Training Partner Fee The yearly fee is collected as divided into 2 installments. These are to be deposited via online transfer to the University account, whose details can be obtained from the Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies (MRIIRS) online website. The fees for the academic year 2023-24 is around 1.75-1.90Lac for Electrical & Electronics Engineering. For detailed Fee-Structure for the specific course, please visit the official website of MRIIRS to ensure Up-to-date information.

faqs.question: What is the fee for FET MRIIRS?
faqs.answer: The fee structure at FET MRIIRS (Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies) can vary based on the program, level of study, and other factors. The institute offers various courses, and each programme may have its own fee structure. For B.Tech. it will cost you around Rs. 8,86,000 somewhere, for B.Sc. Geology honors it will cost you around Rs. 3,78,000, for M.Sc. it will cost you around Rs. 2,52,000 and for M.Tech. it will cost you around Rs. 3,48,000. This all is according to my estimate at this time.

reviews.review_heading: A solid college choice with updated labs, internship opportunities, and improved placement.
reviews.review_text: Our department provides well-maintained infrastructure and facilities to support academic and practical learning. There is also a sports arena where there is a coach of boxing, shooting and many sports instruments. Wi-fi is also available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Manav Rachna campus placement review
reviews.review_text: The department offers good infrastructure, including high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped civil engineering labs, and an updated library with relevant books and journals. The hostels provide clean rooms and essential amenities, and the mess offers decent-quality food with a variety of options.

reviews.review_heading: My learnings during the four years of engineering at Manav Rachna.
reviews.review_text: The labs in our department had good working equipment where practicals could be performed easily. The college library was excellent, having all varieties of books for any branch. I didn't have any problems in searching for books in the library. The library has full Wi-Fi and is air-conditioned. Classrooms were normal, having air conditioning facilities. I didn't stay at the hostel; therefore, I didn't have much idea about it.

reviews.review_heading: Balanced learning environment with strong labs and good placement.
reviews.review_text: MRIIRS has smart classrooms. The labs are quite well-equipped for civil engineering. Especially, we have labs like the survey lab, structure lab, concrete technology lab, soil mechanics lab, and fluid mechanics lab. There is a central library for both digital and physical resources.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of all facilities.
reviews.review_text: MRIIRS has very good infrastructure. The classrooms are clean and air-conditioned. Labs are well-equipped, and the library has a great study environment. Civil Engineering labs like Surveying, Concrete Technology, Environmental, Geotechnical, and Structures are modern and provide hands-on learning. The campus is green, well-maintained, and has strong Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and good canteens.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college if you want to enjoy your college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities are top notch and also the Wi-Fi is very good and connectivity is very good, labs are fully air conditioned and well maintained, classrooms are SMART board equipped and library have more tha 2000 books which is very nice.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfying because of the many facilities and the faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure and facilities, as they provide us with free Wi-Fi, have AC in every classroom, and have 3 big libraries where any student can go and study. The labs are also very good, as they have the latest machines and a good environment.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty members, facilities, infrastructure, and placement.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides well-maintained and structured labs, classroom, library, and overall Wi-Fi is available on campus. Our college has eco-friendly environment. It is highly maintained and hygienic. Quality of food available in the hostel, mess, and canteen is good.

reviews.review_heading: You can take admission if you don't get admission in the top government colleges.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are well-maintained and rooms are of adequate size. Security is maintained 24X7. They also have a sports ground for football and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure and faculty, but placement support needs major improvement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good and the whole cleanliness of the college is maintained 24/7. Labs are equipped with high-tech faculty members. Hotels are also very good and the food provided in the mess is good. As for games a lot of area has been dedicated to it.

reviews.review_heading: The college is not at all worth the money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is poor. In classrooms, you will find wooden benches and one class can have 60 to 65 students crammed into a very small space. The benches are not sufficient for everyone; if all students attend on the same day, half of them will not get a seat. The Wi-Fi is non-existent and never works. Labs are similarly just for namesake; in computer labs, many computers do not work, and in the chemistry lab, you will only be given a few experiments to perform, and typically just one readin...

reviews.review_heading: MRIIRS is a good option for students.
reviews.review_text: There’s a review of the infrastructure for my course and hostel at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies. The infrastructure for my course includes classrooms that are air-conditioned, spacious, and well-maintained. They are equipped with modern teaching aids like projectors, smart boards, and audio-visual equipment. Labs are well-equipped with the latest equipment and software relevant to my course. The lab assistants are helpful and supportive. The library is well-stocke...

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is well maintained. Our college provides separate departments for faculty members. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. Labs and classrooms are very well maintained. A gym is available on the campus. We have huge Libraries. Classrooms have smart boards. Computer labs are well maintained. The food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Manav Rachna University goes beyond academics to focus on the holistic development of its students.
reviews.review_text: We got almost everything in our college that is required for our course. We have every lab for every course, and we have free Wi-Fi for students, which connects through their roll number. We got smart boards and smart classrooms, and we have at least 10 restaurants in our college, and all of them are the best.

reviews.review_heading: Outdated and irrelevant engineering curriculum.

Library at Manav is the main attraction of the entire campus. It is a world class library and has all kinds of reading material from fiction, None fiction to curriculum related books. individual_reviews.title: Analyze before you choose.

content.Placements: The placement faculty is average in this college. Being a government college, Eanchi Women College provides average placement of INR 3L-4L in the commerce field. Recently, there was a placement drive from TCS where 10 students were placed. Companies like Garnier and Jharkhand Gov.. Companies also visit the college. The Science department gets more placements than the commerce department.
content.Infrastructure: The thing that attracted me first towards this college was the infrastructure. The college is full of greenery. Ranchi, being a hill station itself, is full of greenery, which the college also depicts. The campus is huge, with big classrooms, Wi-Fi facilities, an auditorium, water coolers, and washrooms; everything is top-notch. I have not opted for the college hostel, so I cannot provide a review for it, but yes, I have opted for a hostel outside the college, which is very good. All the amenities like Wi-Fi, lift, good food, and good water are provided.

reviews.review_text: The thing that attracted me first towards this college was the infrastructure. The college is full of greenery. Ranchi, being a hill station itself, is full of greenery, which the college also depicts. The campus is huge, with big classrooms, Wi-Fi facilities, an auditorium, water coolers, and washrooms; everything is top-notch. I have not opted for the college hostel, so I cannot provide a review for it, but yes, I have opted for a hostel outside the college, which is very good. All the ameniti...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Ranchi Women's College.
reviews.review_text: The first thing that attracted me was the infrastructure. The college's facilities are commendable. It is filled with trees and sitting areas. Walking in feels like entering a garden. It is also neat and clean. Since I did not opt for the college hostel, I cannot review it. However, the cleanliness and sanitation facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: There are no good placements. The infrastructure is good, fees are quite high according to study.
reviews.review_text: The college has all the necessary resources to support the studies. There is a library, canteen, and hostel provided by the college. The college infrastructure is good, with having a small garden with beautiful flowers. Its location is good because the college is situated in a road area.

reviews.review_heading: College infrastructure is good but not well-maintained.
reviews.review_text: I don't live in the college hostel, I stay in a private hostel. But, from what I've heard from friends and college mates, the food provided there is edible and good. I have visited my friends' rooms and observed that the rooms are spacious and very neat and clean.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the supportive faculty and the non-teaching staff also.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very helpful and supportive in nature. The library is also very good; there are plenty of books which are helpful for the regarding courses. There is an option for online sources in the library. Overall, the environment of the library is very good with supportive staff.

reviews.review_heading: Value for Money and amazed to see the placements of the 2023 batch.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is decent and the college is divided into two blocks: Arts and Science block. Hostels are decent to live in as per the area. You would get good facilities to all basic amenities, and a ground is also within the campus to have sports or free time in.

reviews.review_heading: Ranchi Women's College - a conservative college.
reviews.review_text: The campus only has academic buildings. The classrooms are decent, but there is no availability of projectors or smart boards. Wi-Fi is available in important areas like the reception, but not in the classrooms. Essential facilities like washrooms and drinking water are well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: All about Ranchi Women College: This is the college for management.
reviews.review_text: Every facility that students want and need now is in the college, and off-campus there is a library, gym, lab, banks, a huge campus, events, seminars, and various activities, and the teachers are so supportive. Their teaching skills are so good.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in the city.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is beautiful, especially the ambiance of this college. There are separate classrooms for different branches. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. There are individual libraries for all departments. The library of arts block is much better than the science block.

reviews.review_heading: Decent college for girls in Ranchi.
reviews.review_text: Very nice facilities and faculty members are present in the college, and you have a good library for your personal study. Hostels are also there for students. All types of labs are present for their respective courses, as is a very big playground. Sports and games are also played often.

reviews.review_heading: The not-so-perfect college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is poor to be honest. The classrooms are not clean, some not even properly lit. The library has very few books and is mostly empty. There is no Wi-Fi facility for students there. The hostel in arts block is not good. No canteen facility.

reviews.review_heading:
*Dissatisfied*
Fees is nominal the studies are not.
reviews.review_text: Women's college established in 1954, is under Ranchi University with courses up to postgraduate level in arts, Science and commerce stream. Courses in B.Ed IT and computers have also been started. The college has good infrastructure and faculty and has a glorious past. The road leading to the college is busy and there is parking problem outside.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities provided here are not that good.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is not good enough. Only economically weak students can live there. Many facilities are not provided. The library and labs are adjustable. Equipments in the labs are not proper. Mess food is not that good. A canteen is not available. Medical facilities are also not available. During the winter, the college organises sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members and placements are good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of library, labs, smart classes, etc. are available. Food is good and canteens are also great. Medical facilities are available in the college. All the facilities which are important for the students are commendable.

reviews.review_heading: The college has really good facilities.
reviews.review_text: I can proudly say that the faculty are excellent at teaching and hold Ph.Ds. The college has a hostel for students that provides bonding and learning to students who come from different areas. The site of the hostel is healthy, and the students can join the outer unit cost with 6,000 per month.

PDM University comprises more than 10 departments, including Agriculture, Allied Health Sciences, Commerce & Management Studies, Dental Sciences, Engineering, and others. The affiliated colleges and departments of the university offer a wide range of courses at the UG, PG, diploma, and PhD levels, across various streams. PDM University offers a full-time, two-year MBA programme at the PG level. The MBA programme offered at the university covers core courses in the areas of Marketing Management, Finance, International Business, Organisational Behaviour and Human Resource. The BTech programme offered by the PDM University is a four-year programme. It is offered in several specialisations, including Civil Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science & IT, Electronics & Communication Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering. PDM University Admission Process 2025

PDM University admission process includes online application, Fill Form and upload documents, Application fee, Application Status, Scrutiny of Application and Counselling/Admission. Candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat at PDM University:
STEP 1: PDM University Application Process 2025
Candidates are required to apply online after ensuring eligibility conditions. For online Application, students need to visit the official website https://www.pdm.ac.in/
STEP 2: Fill Form and Upload Documents
Duly filled in all relevant details on the online application form as per guidelines. Upload a recent passport-size photograph and a copy of the signature on the application form.
STEP 3: Application Fee

Complete the application process by paying the Application Fee. The application fee for the year is INR 1,000 (For UG & PG Course) & INR 500 (For Diploma Course). The Application fee payment can be made Online using Credit Card / Debit Card or via Scratch Card. Candidate may choose the payment option Cash payment at PDM also.
STEP 4: Application Status

After submission of the application form online, the system will generate an application number. The application number and details will be mailed to your registered mail address. Aspirants also check the status of the application form by visiting the link which will be available at the official website. Status can be checked by entering the registered mobile no.Candidates are advised to take two copies of the printout. One copy is to be submitted at the time of physical counselling. The second one is to be retained by the applicant.
STEP 5: Scrutiny of Application

Stages of scrutiny: Submitted the approved/rejected; the university admission committee will review each application form. Application forms will be approved / Rejected based on the qualification and other criteria as mentioned in the eligibility. Candidates will be intimidated through SMS or email.
STEP 6: Counselling/Admission
PDM University will send intimation about the Counseling / Admission schedule on the candidate's email address and registered mobile no.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure and amazing facility.

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of PDM UNIVERSITY .

paragraphs: IIGJ Jaipur admissionis open. Indian Institute of Gems and Jewellery, popularly known asIIGJ Jaipuroffers UG, Diploma, and Certificate programmes. It offers courses in different specialisations, including Jewellery Manufacturing & Production, Gem Identification, Jewellery Design, Computer-Aided Jewellery Design & Production and more. The Institute is affiliated toRajasthan ILD Skills University (RISU). It is a training partner of the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihoods Development Corporation (RSLDC) and is promoted by the Gems & Jewellery Export Promotion Council, GoI.IIGJ Jaipuradmissionis direct/merit-based. More details about the course admission atIIGJ Jaipurare provided in the following sections.

The Institute offers admission through an online mode. Candidates, who meet the given eligibility criteria, need to register online for the completeIIGJ Jaipur admission process. Mentioned below are the course-wise eligibility and selection details:

Candidates seeking admission can apply by filling out the admission form. Before applying, aspirants must check that they are fulfilling the required minimum selection criteria. Each of theIIGJ Jaipur course admissionstages are further explained below:
STEP 1: IIGJ Jaipur Application Process 2025

Eligible students can visit the institute's official website (https://iigjjaipur.com/) to apply. All the details in the application form should be filled out carefully and as per the official documentation.
STEP 2: Shortlisting of Students
The institute scans the applications to ensure applicants meet the applied course selection criteria. These shortlisted students further become eligible for admission.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation
Selected candidates can further pay the required fee amount to confirm their seat.

review_summary.college_name: Maratha Vidya Prasarak Samaj's College of Architecture and Centre for Design Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Being honest about my college.

content.Placements: College does not provide any placement assistance. Students need to find placement on their own. Internships at different architectural firms are also monitored under the student's responsibility. After passing, you can apply for junior architect jobs in various design firms.
content.Infrastructure: No hostel facilities are available for boys as of now. There is a girls' hostel available, and it has a fee of 80,000 per year, including mess and other services. The college has the biggest library considering the number of books available. Wi-Fi service is available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of MVP college of architecture .

content.Placements: 80 students per batch are there. The highest package offered may be 6,00,000 and the minimum may be 3,00,000. Our seniors are the best teachers. Some had started their own firms and some had applied to various companies. It's good to apply to this college for architecture .
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a library with all the books necessary for the study of architecture, plus some other books that you can take to read and refresh your mind. The campus has computer labs and a Wi-Fi campus. Our college has a very good environment, which is refreshing with the facilities of drinking water and good sanitation .

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Really good place to learn but lacks a little in providing exposure to the ongoing situations.

content.Placements: There is no placement offered for B.Arch courses. The overall batch has a capacity of about 80 students. The ambiance & atmosphere is very good for overall progress. NASA is also given a good share of importance especially for second & third year students.
content.Infrastructure: Adequate number of classrooms, studios, lecture halls are available along with material, computer lab & library. There is no provision for boys hostel yet. The college also has a dedicated area for sports & games but lacks good quality canteen. The campus is well connected by free - Wi-Fi.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Students can have good campus life.

content.Placements: Only three architecture colleges are available in Nashik, and one college among them is NDMVPS College of Architecture. This college wins NASA trophy every year. You have to do internships to get placed.
content.Infrastructure: The college was built in the year 1989. All facilities are provided for students except hostel. Good and clean studios are available. A computer lab is available. The courtyard is very beautiful. Architectural aesthetics is also maintained. A playground is available for students. All the books related to architecture are available in the college. A canteen is also available. The campus is good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Best College in Nashik for the students who want to pursue architecture degree.

content.Placements: Around 80% of the students who opted for placements in the computer department got placed. The highest salary package offered on campus placements was by Persistent Systems, and it was 6.5 LPA, while the average salary package offered is around 3.5 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is around 2.4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The food available in the canteen is worth of money and affordable for all the students. The campus is fulfilled by basic requirements of ground, basketball court, football ground, gym, library, Wi-Fi enabled departments, well-facilitated classrooms and laboratories.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with College and the course of MBBS is justified when you study from Government College.

content.Placements: Here, in Madhya Pradesh Shah Government Medical College, the students generally get placed in internship in the final year, which is 4.5+1 year of internship, and generally get a stipend of around 21,000, which is good enough to survive the month, and you also get to learn so much knowledge.
content.Infrastructure: Food quality here is very good, as you must not know, but here there is a mess which is maintained by students studying here only, and hence the mess bill is also very minimal, like 3k-4,000 for the month, and also the taste is very good. When it comes to hostel, they are above average. Wi-Fi is not provided, but the minimal things required are present, which is enough you may expect for 1200 fees for hostel per year.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: College experience is positive and satisfying.

content.Placements: 60 percent students got placed with an average package of 4 LPA. Top recruiters include Cognizant and LTI Mindtree. 50 percent students secured internships gaining valuable industry exposure. The most offered role is software engineer, reflecting strong demand in tech fields.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are available making daily life convenient and hassle free. The quality of facilities is fairly good around 8 out of 10 ensuring comfort and reliability. Most essential things are located within walking distance adding to the ease of accessibility and convenience.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good engineering college for CSE and AIML students with decent opportunities.

content.Placements: Placements at ITM Gwalior are decent, mainly for CSE and AIML branches. Companies like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Capgemini, Tech Mahindra, and some startups visit every year. The average package range between 4 LPA to 5 LPA, while the highest goes up to 10 LPA to 12 LPA depending on skills. Mass recruiters hire in bulk, but a few product-based companies also offer good roles. Internship opportunities are available, but students need to be proactive. Placements for core (non-CS) branches are limited, so many students opt for off-campus drives. Overall, ITM Gwalior provides good placement chances for students targeting the IT sector.

individual_reviews.course: B.Ed. in Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Great academic experience with helpful faculty members and good labs.

content.Placements: Around 60-70% of students are placed from our batch. The highest package is around 6 LPA, the lowest is approximately 2 LPA, and the average package is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies included TCS, Infosys, Zydus, and Torrent Pharma. Many students get internships through the college placement cell in companies like Sun Pharma and Cadila. Top roles offered are research analyst, quality control executive, and production chemist.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the department is well developed with advanced laboratories, fast Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostel facilities are good, with regular maintenance and 24X7 security. The mess food is hygienic and offers both veg and non-veg options. There are medical facilities available on campus. It has sports grounds for cricket, football, and indoor games like table tennis and badminton.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Best tier 3 college in our city.

content.Placements: Placements are high in our college. The average package is also 4 lakh. Companies like IBM and TCS visit our college for the placements, and most teaching roles are filled from our college, as well as management roles. The training is also done by the college for the placements.
content.Infrastructure: The college is equipped with multiple labs. All of them are air-conditioned. They are designed for the best learning experience, and the experienced staff helps us to maintain the lab in the best possible manner. The mess food is also really good in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good college with good infrastructure and facilities of AMU.

content.Placements: In branches like Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence, almost 70-80 per cent of students get placed in decent companies at decent packages of 6 to 18 LPA. The average is 7-8 LPA, while the median is also approximately the same, around 8-10 LPA. content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of the college are good enough. Classrooms also have smart boards. Labs are fully working, and everything needed for experiments or project work is available. Wi-Fi works properly with high speed in hostels, but is a little weak in college. We have various games to play, like table tennis, chess, carrom, hockey, cricket, football, and there is a swimming pool in which we can dive.

individual_reviews.title: Not a good experience. Over expensive and not worth it.

content.Placements: No one from my batch was given any placement. So technically, doing the course will not get you employed. All the internships that are relevant to the field can be done by you, but almost all of them are unpaid (with some even requiring you to pay, eg, Claws makes you pay Rs. 5,000 for an internship). Apart from this, relating to any other city and the living expenses, it will ruin you financially. Even after all this, there is no guarantee of any kind of decent placement. From my batch, people went on internships, but none got placed.
content.Infrastructure: University infrastructure is pretty good with all amenities (AC classrooms, lifts, washing machines, etc.). Moreover, cleanliness is maintained all the time. The quality of food is too good, so I won’t comment on the taste. We have a medical center that runs 24 hours. Apart from the mess, there are also different cafes available.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for those who are interested in the field of Cybersecurity and not for others
reviews.review_text: It has hi-tech labs with a hi-tech PC and i9 processor, 4090 GPU, 64 GB RAM, and 2 TB storage. There are 3 to 4 labs. It has a dedicated networking lab, AI lab, and digital forensics lab. It has AC classrooms. There are 3 to 4 grounds for games like cricket, football, and volleyball. It has good hostels and decent food in the mess.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty members and the exposure.
reviews.review_text: In our university, the infrastructure is too good as compared of other Government Universities. We do have air-conditioning classes. We have a library available for students that is accessible for the whole day and night. The quality and hygiene of food are maintained but the taste of mess is not that good.

reviews.review_heading: A university of national importance with good infrastructure available.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided here are top-notch. Our classrooms have air conditioning, and smart boards, In our hostel, the authorities provide huge rooms with four-person sharing. Washing machines are available for students, but they are paid. There is also a medical centre that is open 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: It is a university that is relevant for future generations.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided here are top-notch as compared to other central universities. Every class is air-conditioned and the faculty members here use new methods of teaching like visuals. In every class, there is a smart board. Our college provides good quality internet (Wi-Fi). In our library, there are plenty of books for students to read. There is one dedicated reading room with a capacity of around 100 students. We do have a good medical center that is available for 24 hours. Food quality is goo...

reviews.review_heading: Good Infrastructure, faculty, mess food, well-maintained campus, and hostels are spacious.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good. Lush green campus, full campus Wi-Fi enabled, classrooms are well furnished, and AC equipped. Library is very large and has a good huge reading room. Hostel facilities are very good, mess food quality is good enough. They have a dedicated medical facility and have all the outdoor sports like cricket ground, football ground, basketball court, volleyball court, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college as infrastructure is very good, facilities are awesome, and average placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good. It provides lush green campus, full campus Wi-Fi enabled, classrooms are well furnished, and AC equipped. The library is very large and has a huge reading room. Facility of the hostel is very good. Mess food quality is good enough. We have a dedicated medical facility. We also have all the outdoor sports like cricket ground, football ground, basketball court, volleyball court, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Great placements and strong faculty members.
reviews.review_text: RRU offers smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, advanced cyber labs, library access, hostels (3,000 per month), hygienic multi-cuisine mess, 24X7 medical care, and sports like football, cricket, gym, and indoor games. It ensures academic and holistic growth.

reviews.review_heading: College life is the best life.
reviews.review_text: The department is very good structure. Infrastructure is also very good. The Wi-Fi facility is good. Classrooms are also good as there is AC, fan, digital tv, etc. Library is also available. They provide all the facilities. The food quality is so nice. The canteen is good. Medical facilities are nice. In terms of sports and games, it is extremely good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the overall campus and academic facilities.
reviews.review_text: RRU offers modern academic facilities like 24/7 Wi-Fi. The college has well-equipped labs, and a 24/7 library facility for supporting effective learning. The hostels are comfortable with 4 students in a single room, and also the medical facilities are available 24/7 with skillful and professional doctors and staff members. While the sports facilities are excellent and cater to a wide range, they provide an opportunity to play directly in Zone-level games. The infrastructure of Mess is excellent,...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rashtriya Raksha University.
reviews.review_text: College has very good infrastructure and also provides various facilities like reading room, gym, library, and sports facilities. They also provide 24-hour medical facilities. Food in the mess is very good and they provide multiple cuisines on consecutive days and offer four meals a day.
